reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses splat morphology and melting behavior for a different HEA (AlCoCrFeNiSi) and notes that wide particle size ranges cause unmelted or semi-molten particles, which contradicts the premise that larger particles will fully melt under unchanged parameters.
